Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 46

“As much use as there is in a well when water is flooding everywhere, so much use is there in all the Vedas for the knowing brahmana.”

A carefully limited image. The well is not condemned — it simply becomes redundant once the flood arrives. Scripture is a means, and the point is arriving at what it points toward.
